train_effects.adaptive_level_policy: Observed independent native controller, not forced; paired actual quality levels must agree. Precipitation high/2048 does not imply2048 live train particles.

cache_policy.cold: Fresh private player-data + XDG/Mesa caches for each A1/B1/B2/A2 block; no application/driver cache reuse across blocks
cache_policy.warm: Second process in the same block with its existing player/driver caches and unchanged settings/resources
cache_policy.os_page_cache: Not globally flushed; explicitly not disk-cold. Do not call it OS/disk cold.
cache_policy.original_content: Read only; no clearing user caches or install content

quiet_control.ambient_scope: Lightweight GitHub annotations/monitoring/conversation and untouched user desktop/services are ambient, not stopped or asserted absent. Record them; do not touch user processes.

higher_whole_launch_utilization_observat.scope: Observed whole-launch utilization, not a latency or total-CPU-time conclusion; global GPU busy can include desktop/compositor.

external_process_memory.scope: Symmetric1Hz selected-PCI observations only; D9 legacy internal GPU memory excluded. All seven counters and three uncertain phase boundaries stay distinct. Higher VRAM measurements remain reported; no blanket saving claim.

capture_review.method: tools.view_image on all eight original local PNGs, plus Root visual checks recorded in the immutable release receipt. Frame hashes/dimensions were verified; no regenerated or edited image.
capture_review.accepted_scope: Fixed original driver-cab composition, complete nearby scene, coherent lighting/rain/materials/HUD and legible instruments.
limitations: Congruent composition is not pixel equality or the same effective GPU workload.
All frames are driver cab; this does not exercise actual key2 transition in the final Snap.

timing_scope.journey: JourneyPerformance counts Time<Real> render-world intervals once perPlayingUpdate; DevMetrics samples Last-to-Last after60ready frames, CPU First-to-Last. No claim of physical presented frames.
timing_scope.diagnostics: DevMetrics frame intervals are Last-to-Last after60 ready frames; CPU is First-to-Last. GPU is the longest instrumented span, not summed nested passes or a presented whole GPU frame.
timing_scope.input: Synthetic queue-to-next-ECS-frame samples, not physical key-to-display latency.
timing_scope.startup: Keep whole-run quantiles/maxima/hitches, startup longest frame, producer loading counter and explicit bootstrap/capture log markers. Startup P50/P95/P99 are not exported separately and are not inferred from whole-run values.
timing_scope.phase_counts: Producer frame/loading/gameplay counts are retained exactly; they are not assumed to form a disjoint partition or summed to invent additional observations.
timing_scope.memory: Separate external observer phases retain exact log brackets and boundary ambiguity. They are not frame-timing phases or first-presented/scene-ready timestamps.

limits: Only the frozen2500m/default2000m/downpour/Pullman8/driver55deg RX/Vulkan/privateWayland/AutoVsync contract; no generalFPS, full-service, OR pixel/physics parity or allocator-isolated claim.
All eight actual launches and captures are retained. Cold means fresh private application/Mesa caches, not flushed OS/disk caches; warm is a second process in the same block.

Configured quality is constant and adaptive changes are zero, but actual residency is8 baseline vs11 candidate GPU tiles. CPU tiles are30 in every run; baseline gpu_entities15929–15976 vs candidate21022–21078 and WORLD draw counts differ. No identical-workset or isolated-component causality claim.

Gameplay P95 worsens in all four pairs even while primary P99/max improve; all positive deltas in the declared timing/latency secondary grid and all higher utilization observations are retained, not copied from38.
GPU span P50/P95/P99 are higher in all four pairs; they never replace primary journey P99. Preserve input-queue and CPU quantile regressions as reported.

All external memory regressions are separately enumerated by PID/PCI/counter/phase in the linked receipt. Observed1Hz maxima and kernel VmHWM are not every physical peak; no homogeneous total-GPU-memory or global reduction claim.
Baseline D9 internal device totals aggregate adapters and are excluded from memory comparisons. Raw originals retain those fields for provenance.
Geometry-cache warm disk_bytes=0 is retained producer telemetry with inventory_scans=0, not a claim that the private cache is empty; cold writes and warm hits are preserved separately.
No current final-Snap Jugar/cab/key2/exterior execution is supplied here. #381 remains pending that shared native transition; this receipt does not close any issue or certify7200 stability.

shared_run_field_scopes.host_usage.scope: whole launch including loading; selected DRM device has largest observed process VRAM; global busy includes compositor/other processes
shared_run_field_scopes.timings.scope: Explicit application log markers only; null presentation/physical-ready times were not exported and are not inferred from bootstrap or capture.
shared_run_field_scopes.diagnostics.gpu_time_scope: longest instrumented render span; nested passes are not summed
shared_run_field_scopes.diagnostics.input_latency_scope: synthetic queue to next ECS frame; excludes hardware and display
shared_run_field_scopes.capture.review: Original cab, track/terrain/fences/vegetation, rain, instruments and HUD are complete and compositionally congruent. PAUSA is the intended final capture state; no central pause panel or loading screen.
shared_run_field_scopes.workset.draw_calls.scope: actual WORLD/grass submissions; excludes Standard PBR, UI and Hanabi
